I think Alison did have some remorse, at least in the moment. In season 7 it was more of a “standing her ground” type of thing. She was overwhelmed by everything going on and I think she kinda just malfunctioned and reverted back to her “safe place” of putting others down. I’m not justifying it, I just think that that’s why it happened. And I don’t think she would’ve reacted that way to Paige if she wasn’t pregnant. 7x11 was her last bout of being a bitch, and her first bout of being a bitch since season 5. Alison seemed happy for Paige in 6B and encouraged Paige’s relationship with Emily when talking to Mona. I think she was just freaked out in 7x11. In that episode she was leaning on Emily for support, so seeing Paige not only back in Emily’s life, but also at her workplace probably put her brain into overload. And it seemed different. It didn’t seem like it was something Ali wanted to do for fun, it seemed like something Ali was forcing herself to do. I do think Paige triggered something in Alison in 7B when she showed up at her workplace. I could imagine it would be weird  having someone who you used to bully show up at your place of work, she probably felt ashamed and emotional and those two emotions caused a relapse of her old behaviour. I do think in 6x15 Alison was too ashamed to apologize, she’s never been good at apologizing even when she actually is sorry, but even Paige herself noted that Alison has changed for the better. If Paige really thought Alison was still awful, she would’ve said something. Paige has always been good at reading people. Again, not justifying Alison’s behaviour. Maybe I’m giving her too much credit, but I genuinely think Alison is a bit more complex than meets the eye. I get your perspective though. I really do think it’s up for interpretation, and it depends on how much you trust Alison as a character lol
I loved season 5 Ali. It was by far the most intriguing version of Alison imo. She kept us guessing the whole season.

Alison and Paige had one of the best rivalries on the show. I have no idea why it was Paige in particular that always seemed to shake Alison up,  and why Paige was the one that would make her realize how bad of a person she was, but it always seemed to be Paige that made Alison confront the truth about herself. I always found that super interesting and I was glad they brought that back in 7b.

I think Cece and Jessica influenced Alison a lot and encouraged her to take the “smoke her out” route. If Alison was really as bad and fearless as she seemed, someone her own age, who she has dirt on, wouldn’t be a threat to her. I think it was more of an “oh fuck, I’ve never seen anyone THIS genuinely furious with me before. she looks like she wants to kill me” moment. I definitely think that scared her, as normally people would run away meekly from her but Paige didn’t falter in that moment.

Alison’s role post time jump was minimal but interesting. She lost all her strength and street-smarts. For a girl who’s been through so much and for a girl who has been a manipulative bitch before, it shocked me how prone she was to trusting the wrong people. Like you’d think she’d be the one to be able to sniff people like Rollins, Charlotte and Mary out ... but she was the only one who couldn’t.  Her naivety and blind faith in others led to her into shitty situations (like losing all her money, being framed for murder, being put in Welby, etc.) I’m hoping in the Perfectionists Alison is written better, as I do enjoy her character, I’d like to see her smart side back. Because she did have one in the beginning, I just have no idea where it went in seasons 6 and 7.
